# Facundo Presa

> Entrepreneur, designer and developer based in Uruguay. Started programming at
> 14 to build a FiveM roleplay server. Founder of WeFaber (a software and applied
> AI studio), Eternum (student productivity software), Talentum (talent
> management) and Novum (geopolitical Minecraft). Builds products end to end —
> mostly Bun, TypeScript, React 19, and local-first or browser-only tooling.

This site is a portfolio organised as a chronological timeline: a background
section, then every project grouped into eras, each with a long-form story and
its evolution over time. Available in English and Spanish.

## Projects

- [WeFaber](https://wefaber.net): Software and applied AI studio from Uruguay.
  Started as Itica in 2025, rebranded in 2026.
- [Eternum](https://eternum.lat): Class team building productivity software for
  students, aiming to be a local reference in Uruguay — tools, resources, papers
  and books. Lux is its product; OhMy grew out of the same goal.
- [Lux](https://lux.eternum.lat): SGRSI — IT resource and service management for
  UTU. Equipment, tickets, loans and service requests across four roles
  (Super Admin, Administrator, Technician, Requester). Bun, React 19,
  TailwindCSS v4, Radix UI, with an MSW mock layer powering the public demo.
- [JobIt](https://jobs.wefaber.net): Uruguayan job board covering every field,
  built for people looking for their first job. Filters by field, department and
  schedule, a no-experience flag, saved and discarded listings, and state
  listings from Uruguay Concursa. Bun + Elysia API, React 19 front end, scrapers
  writing a JSON feed.
- [OhMy](https://ohmy.lat): Eternum's tool suite — small browser-only apps for
  mail, docs, grids, forms, charts, gantt and diagrams. No account, no
  server-side data. The diagram editor does UML 2.5 use-case diagrams with a
  live validation checklist.
- [LearnIt](https://github.com/faku-org/learnit): AI-powered language learning.
  LLM-generated learning paths, SM-2 spaced repetition, adaptive difficulty and
  a calibration flow. Astro, React 19, Elysia, MongoDB, Deepseek.
- [SearchIt](https://github.com/faku-org/searchit): Tauri desktop app that turns
  a photographer's raw photo dump into a searchable archive — faces, GPS, OCR
  and CLIP embeddings, indexed entirely on-device.
- [MindVault](https://github.com/faku-org/mindvault): Knowledge externalization
  with dynamic graphs — typed memories, append-only versioning, co-evolving with
  AI agents.
- [Cipher](https://github.com/faku-org/cipher): End-to-end encrypted messaging
  and file sharing with zero data retention. Proof of concept.
- [Talentum](https://talentum.live): Talent management — resources, information
  and content for content creators and anyone who goes public, speakers and
  presenters included.
- [Ad Astra](https://adastrarp.com): FiveM roleplay server with an immersive
  world and human-written storytelling. The first project, built at 14.
- [Novum](https://github.com/novum-org): A Minecraft world built on geopolitics —
  territory escalating from camps to nations and blocs, with invasions, wars, a
  power balance, an economy with its own currencies, and an RPG layer of skills,
  quests, clans and reputation.
- [Libraria](https://libraria.wefaber.net): Visual component builder with a theme
  engine — manual-first, AI-assisted.
